response.overview: Hyun-ho, who borrowed a loan, was unable to pay back the money on the promised date, and eventually he was tortured, imprisoned in a warehouse with his wife. Chun-sik, a loan shark, initially refused to lend the money, but he couldn't turn a blind eye to Hyun-ho, who begged for his wife's hospital bills, and gave the money away. However, Hyun-ho confirms that he has not paid back his debt and lives in gambling with that money. Chun-sik collapses between his guilt and anger of kidnapping Hyun-ho and his wife Ji-won, and Hyun-ho turns into a beast toward him. Hyun-ho brutally murders Chun-sik, and the tip of his sword eventually goes to Ji-won, his wife, too...
